purpose: USGS Water Data OGC API (https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v1) through the aihydro-data adapter: daily and continuous discharge with per-value approval/qualifier, monitoring locations, and gauge resolution. Replaces the waterservices / NWIS path (decommissioned 2027-02-22).
install: pip install 'aihydro-data>=0.2.3' (requests + pandas only; no dataretrieval needed)

get_daily(site, start, end, parameter_co.returns: UsgsSeries: site_id ('USGS-xxxxxxxx'), time_series_id, units_native, frame, quality_summary, upstream
get_daily(site, start, end, parameter_co.frame_columns: time, value_native, value_m3s, negative_flag, approval_status (Approved|Provisional), approval_code (A|P), qualifier (list of raw tokens), qualifier_code ('e' for ESTIMATED, other tokens raw)
get_daily(site, start, end, parameter_co.units: value_native is in units_native exactly as the API states ('ft^3/s'); value_m3s uses the single exact factor 0.028316846592. Unknown units raise USGS_UNIT_UNKNOWN.

get_continuous(site, start, end, paramet.time: UTC instants; windows over 1095 days are chunked (the server rejects more than 1100)

get_monitoring_locations(ids=, bbox=, na.returns: MonitoringLocation: site_id, name, lon, lat ([lon, lat]; the API does not state the CRS), hydrologic_unit_code, horizontal_datum, drainage_area_raw (unit unstated in the body; USGS documents square miles)
get_monitoring_locations(ids=, bbox=, na.note: ids: unknown id raises USGS_SITE_NOT_FOUND. name is an EXACT match; partial name matching is not used (name_contains is refused).

resolve_gauge(geometry=, gauge_id=, basi.returns: GaugeResolution: site, method (explicit_id | basin_ref_alias | outlet_snap), distance_m, comid, candidates, alias_verified, area_check, warnings
resolve_gauge(geometry=, gauge_id=, basi.precedence: explicit gauge_id > BasinRef usgs: alias > outlet. Thresholds are pre-registered (ADR-003 A2) and not an agent-facing option.

gotchas: Refusals are final. TerminalSourceError (GAUGE_REQUIRED, GAUGE_NOT_FOUND, GAUGE_AMBIGUOUS, USGS_NO_DATA, USGS_MULTIPLE_SERIES, ...) means the gauge or series cannot be established; never answer it with another source or modelled flow. Transport failures (USGS_RATE_LIMITED, USGS_TIMEOUT, ...) are plain SourceUnavailable: retry later.

The approval field is approval_status (Approved / Provisional), a separate field from qualifier. Qualifier tokens outside A/P/e (ESTIMATED is 'e'; FORCEINTERPOLATION, ice, equipment ...) are kept raw and counted in quality_summary['qualifiers_other'].
Negative discharge values are flagged (negative_flag, n_negative) and kept; they can be real at tidal or backwater sites.
Last-Modified and ETag were not sent by the server in the recorded session; upstream records response sha256 and retrieval time instead.
An API key (env API_USGS_PAT) is only needed if 429 responses occur; it is sent as the X-Api-Key header and never recorded.
Provisional data is revised by USGS: cache entries with provisional values expire (AIHYDRO_DATA_PROVISIONAL_TTL_DAYS, default 7).
AIHYDRO_USGS_BACKEND=legacy_waterservices is a temporary rollback switch removed on 2027-01-08.

common_patterns.daily_discharge:
from aihydro_data.sources import usgs_waterdata as uw
ser = uw.get_daily('01013500', '2000-01-01', '2009-12-31')
q = ser.frame.set_index('time')['value_m3s']
print(ser.quality_summary['provisional_fraction'], ser.upstream['response_sha256'])
common_patterns.through_the_tool: data_fetch(variable='streamflow', geometry='01013500', start='2000-01-01', end='2009-12-31', session_id=...)  # writes the session streamflow slot with qualification codes
common_patterns.explicit_gauge: data_fetch(variable='streamflow', geometry=<basin polygon>, gauge_id='01013500', start=..., end=...)
